account.signOutBody: Your synced data stays on the server. Anything not yet uploaded will be removed from this device.

amountEntry.descriptionHint: Optional. What this one was for.

categoryForm.recurringSubtitle: Book this income once a month

categoryForm.deleteBody:
What should happen to the amounts recorded against it?

Keep them and the money stays in your totals, without a category. Delete them and it leaves your totals too.
categoryForm.nameTaken: You already have a category called "$name"

overrun.title: Unusual months
overrun.description: A category is outlined when this month costs more than the $months before it usually did.
overrun.saveFailed: Could not save your warning settings

goal.title: Goal
goal.removeBody: Your months stay exactly as they are — only the target goes.
goal.includesStarting: $starting you already had, $months from good months
goal.noGoalWithSavings: Set a target and this becomes progress towards it.
goal.noGoalEmpty: Set a target, then every month you finish up counts towards it.
goal.noPositiveMonths: No month has finished up yet. A month counts once its income beats its spending.
goal.negativeNote: $months ended down, $amount in total. Those are left out of the figure above.
goal.formSubtitle: Every month you finish up adds to it.
goal.alreadySavedHint: Optional. What you had put aside before this app.
goal.startingBelowZero: Enter an amount of zero or more

debts.title: Debts
debts.deleteBody: $amount will stop being tracked. Nothing in your spending changes — a debt was never part of it.
debts.emptyBody: Add what you owe and what people owe you. Debts are tracked here only — they never move your spending totals.
debts.enterCounterparty: Enter who the debt is with

currencies.title: Currencies
currencies.empty: No currencies yet. Everything is in $base.
currencies.removeBody: Amounts already recorded keep the values they were saved with.
currencies.baseSheetSubtitle: What every amount is recorded in, and what rates are quoted against.
currencies.switchKept: Amounts already recorded keep the numbers they were saved with — they will be shown in $ticker from now on.
currencies.switchDeletes: The currencies you added are quoted against $base, so they cannot be kept: $tickers will be deleted.
currencies.switchAdopts: $ticker leaves your added currencies as well — it is the base now, so there is no rate left for it to hold.
currencies.tickerFormat: Tickers are 2 to 10 letters or digits
currencies.rateAboveZero: The exchange rate must be above zero
currencies.baseChangeFailed: Could not change the base currency

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Up to $count accounts of your own, and one family account you and your partner both record into.
accounts.removeBody: Its categories and entries stop showing anywhere in the app. Nothing is erased, but there is no way back to them from here.
accounts.noRoom: You have $count accounts of your own and a family account. Remove one to make another.
accounts.inviteWarning: Anyone with this code can join and see these totals.
accounts.rotateBody: The old code stops working. Anyone who has already joined stays.
accounts.leaveBody: You stop seeing these totals, and your partner stops seeing yours. The entries you have already recorded here stay in this account.
accounts.joinBlocked: Leave the family account you are in to join another.
accounts.formPersonalLimit: You already have $count of your own. Remove one to make another.
accounts.formFamilyLimit: You are already in a family account. Leave it before starting another.
accounts.formPersonalAbout: Its own categories and totals, kept separate from your other accounts.
accounts.formFamilyAbout: One set of categories and totals that you and your partner both record into.
accounts.createFamilyFailed: Could not create that family account
accounts.notYoursToOpen: That account is not yours to open
accounts.notYoursToRemove: That account is not yours to remove
accounts.enterCode: Enter the code your partner shared with you
accounts.cannotLeaveOwn: Your own account is not one you can leave
accounts.firstMustStay: Your first account has to stay
accounts.leaveRatherThanRemove: Leave a family account rather than removing it
accounts.onlyOwnerRotates: Only whoever created it can change the code
accounts.joinedPending: You're in. It will show up here once syncing catches up.
accounts.personalLimitReached: You can have up to $count accounts of your own. Remove one to make another.
accounts.familyLimitReached: You are already in a family account. Leave it before joining or starting another.
accounts.codeUnusable: That code could not be used

accounts.codeNeedsAccount: Sign in to share a family account with someone.
accounts.noFreeCode: Could not come up with an invite code
